justifications.c1: One niche figure: Tendring leisure-centre shower Legionella case, £27k fine + ~£7.2k costs (search-confirmed); larger fines (£900k Sanctuary, £600k Amey) are housing and prisons; flushing labour and contractor monitoring cost are unquantified, so loss vs TCO of £168-per-pipe sensors is not shown.
justifications.c2: HSE's own page (search-confirmed) sets monthly sentinel temperature checks and weekly flushing of infrequently used outlets, corroborated by the Redditch log book, DIO guidance and NI sports-centre weekly flushing rounds; caveat that HSG274 does not define 'little use'.
justifications.c3: Documented weekly staff flushing rounds, monthly contractor sentinel checks (LiveWest), weekly staff travel to sports-centre sites (Londonderry Sentinel) and paper records, but no minutes, hours or per-outlet contractor price found.
justifications.c4: HSE L8/HSG274 web guidance requires monthly checks and recording (primary, search-confirmed), with 5-year retention from secondary sources; enforcement in the niche: Tendring leisure-centre showers prosecution, HSE 2025 Legionella prosecutions deck, care-home case citing poor flushing of little-used outlets.
justifications.c5: Legionella compliance roles are evidenced with salaries (KCL £54–63k, Estates Legionella Manager £37–44k, Waverley compliance officer), but none at a leisure operator and none states purchasing budget.
justifications.c6: Water-hygiene contractors visit monthly (LiveWest) and already sell remote pipe-temperature monitoring (PTSG Water RTM 2026, SOCOTEC ClipR), and chemical firms partner with sensor makers (Sontay/H2O); these channels double as competitors.
justifications.c7: Crowded: Nano Sensorics (£168), SPICA, Invisible Systems, aquavision aquaflush, Connexin, InferSens, TEKTELIC, Checkit, PTSG, SOCOTEC, and Sfella and CreevX already target sports-centre showers specifically; no subscription prices and the leisure-package gap is inference.
justifications.c8: Off-the-shelf LoRaWAN pipe sensors exist (Nano Sensorics £168 each, search-confirmed single listing, 10-yr battery claimed) and four-pipe nodes cut per-outlet cost, but the per-outlet BOM is above ~£50 and HSE acceptance of pipe-surface sensing is unconfirmed.
justifications.c9: Weekly flushing and monthly checks recur for the building's life, with 5-year records (secondary) and existing monthly contractor spend, but no comparable product subscription price is evidenced.
justifications.c10: Regulator/enforcement (HSE Tendring prosecution, BOHS deck), news (ITV Channel Les Quennevais, Barnet Post Hampstead Heath, Kent Online Hythe) and trade press (PWTAG, PFM, Health Club Management); no first-hand forum or review complaints.

weakest: Crowded and contractor-owned: a dozen pipe-temperature vendors exist, Sfella and CreevX already pitch sports-centre showers, and the water-hygiene contractors who would be the channel (PTSG, SOCOTEC) sell their own sensors.
